newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium to sell 25 pct ASLK stake this year - Gvt.
newsitem.headline: Belgium to sell 25 pct ASLK stake this year - Gvt.

text.p: Belgian Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene told a news conference on Tuesday that as part of a 70 billion franc state asset sale programme in the next two years, the government would sell a 25 percent stake in bank ASLK/CGER before the end of this year.
Dehaene said he thought the 25 percent stake would raise about 25 billion francs.
"Our target is to realise this operation before the end of this year," he said.
Dehaene said it was not sure if the sale would be done via a direct negotiation with Belgian-Dutch insurance and banking group Fortis or via a bourse listing.
"In the case of a bourse listing we could run into a traffic jam," he said.

Generale Bank is currently finalising a 15 billion franc capital increase, while Belgian publicly-owned bank Credit Communal/Gemeentekrediet (CCB) plans a 30 billion franc partial bourse listing in november.
